note: Drive-in loops on the north shore of Eleven Mile Reservoir, ~8,600 ft; open, treeless ground running down to the water. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop per-site pages: confirmed 24 sites (301-324, basic, 35-120 ft, 6 pull-throughs), no electric (and no water/sewer), reservation-only on cpwshop; added seasonal (closes Nov 1), url/window 180/fcfs never/14-night max. Fees ($28) and facilities left as stored. Note: dropped the site-count/amenity/booking restatements, 'long pads' and 'Camp Colorado'.
flags: Waterfront (stored lakefront): cpwshop tags all 24 Stoll Mountain sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'. On Esri imagery the two loops run down open, treeless ground to the north shore; the shore-row sites (305-307, 319-322) sit ~20-60 m from the waterline in that image, the back row (301, 302, 311) ~120-150 m. Pool level unknown. No contrary claim.
Pin 38.9492,-105.5286 is at the entrance off the park road, 147 m from the 24-site centroid (38.94803,-105.52941).
Season: the CPW page gives only the November 1 closing for Stoll Mountain, no opening date.
